casaDelAgua.copy: A truly sustainable project: rainwater, 100% purified, collected in Mexico, conceived as an infinitely recyclable option, from the origin and collection process to the packaging and recycling. It is part of an experience conceived from coherence: a shared vision in which design, environmental awareness and attention to detail are naturally integrated into the way we understand premium mobility. Integrated as a courtesy detail within the onboard experience.

rodasTs.copy: Rod Torres, a visual creator specialized in reels and visual stories, developed Pixkuy Mobility’s Lego-style promotional video: a piece designed to tell our private mobility story through a closer, more memorable and distinctive visual language. A creative collaboration to present Pixkuy from another angle: less corporate, more visual, and aligned with a brand that seeks to stand out also in the way it communicates. Audiovisual creation applied to our brand communication.
